channel.title: Claude Code Live Cheatsheet
channel.description: Auto-updating cheatsheet for Claude Code — keyboard shortcuts, commands, tips, and more.

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.159 highlights
item.description:
• Auto mode available on Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry for Opus 4.7/4.8 (v2.1.158)
  • Plugins in .claude/skills auto-loaded, no marketplace required (v2.1.157)
  • claude plugin init scaffolds new plugins in .claude/skills (v2.1.157)
  • EnterWorktree switches between Claude-managed worktrees mid-session (v2.1.157)
  • Workflow keyword trigger setting controls auto-triggering in /config (v2.1.157)
  • Dynamic workflows: orchestrate work across tens to hundreds of agents (v2.1.154)

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.158
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

+ [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_AUTO_MODE: Enable auto mode on Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry for Opus 4.7/4.8
~ [workflows-tips] Auto mode: Built-in for Max; Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry via CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_AUTO_MODE
- [config-env] OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.157
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

+ [cli-flags] claude plugin init <name>: Scaffold a new plugin in .claude/skills
+ [config-env] workflowKeywordTrigger: Toggle 'workflow' keyword triggering dynamic workflows
+ [config-env] OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS: Include tool params (bash cmds, MCP/skill names) in OTEL
+ [workflows-tips] EnterWorktree (switch): Switch between Claude-managed worktrees mid-session
~ [skills-agents] .claude/skills/<name>/: Project skills (auto-loaded as plugins)
- [cli-flags] claude project purge [path]
- [config-env] worktree.bgIsolation
- [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_STOP_HOOK_BLOCK_CAP

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.154
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

+ [keyboard-shortcuts] ←←: Open agents view
+ [slash-commands] /workflows: View dynamic workflow runs
+ [slash-commands] /chrome: Select connected browser for Chrome integration
+ [slash-commands] /logout: Sign out (in agents view)
+ [cli-flags] claude --bg --exec '<cmd>': Run shell command as attachable background session
+ [config-env] defaultEnabled: Plugin default disabled in plugin.json; enable with /plugin
+ [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID: Session ID passed to stdio MCP server subprocesses
+ [skills-agents] /simplify: Cleanup-only review (reuse, simplify, efficiency, altitude) and apply fixes
+ [workflows-tips] Dynamic workflows: Ask Claude to create; orchestrates tens to hundreds of agents
~ [slash-commands] /effort [level]: Set effort; interactive slider (low–max; Faster/Smarter labels)
~ [skills-agents] Workflow: Dynamic multi-agent orchestration (opt-in); /workflows to view runs
~ [workflows-tips] 1M context: Opus 4.8 (Max/Team/Ent)
~ [workflows-tips] /effort: ○ low · ◐ med · ◑ xhigh · ● high/max (Faster↔Smarter)
~ [mcp-servers] claude mcp list: List all servers (⏸ = pending approval)
- [keyboard-shortcuts] Ctrl+U
- [slash-commands] /scroll-speed
- [slash-commands] /color [color]
- [slash-commands] /tui [fullscreen]
- [cli-flags] --channels
- [config-env] worktree.baseRef
- [config-env] OTEL_METRICS_INCLUDE_ENTRYPOINT

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.153
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

~ [slash-commands] /model [model]: Switch model (←→ effort, s = this session only)

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.152
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

+ [slash-commands] /reload-skills: Re-scan skill directories without restarting
+ [skills-agents] disallowed-tools: Remove tools from model while skill is active
+ [config-env] pluginSuggestionMarketplaces: Allowlist org marketplaces for plugin suggestions
+ [config-env] reloadSkills: SessionStart: re-scan skills so new ones are available
+ [config-env] sessionTitle: SessionStart: set session title on startup and resume
+ [config-env] MessageDisplay: Transform or hide assistant message text as displayed
+ [cli-flags] --fallback-model: Switch to this model when primary is not found
+ [keyboard-shortcuts] / (vim NORMAL): Reverse history search (like Ctrl+R)
~ [skills-agents] /code-review [effort]: Code review with effort; --comment for inline PR comments, --fix to apply findings
~ [workflows-tips] Auto mode: No opt-in consent needed; built-in for Max subscribers
- [config-env] ANTHROPIC_BEDROCK_SERVICE_TIER
- [config-env] DISABLE_UPDATES
- [config-env] PostToolUseFailure
- [config-env] PermissionDenied
- [config-env] PreCompact
- [cli-flags] --exclude-dynamic-system-prompt-sections
- [keyboard-shortcuts] Ctrl+E
- [slash-commands] /chrome

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.143
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

+ [config-env] worktree.bgIsolation: none — background sessions edit working copy directly (no worktree)
+ [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_POWERSHELL_RESPECT_EXECUTION_POLICY: Opt out of PowerShell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass
+ [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_USE_POWERSHELL_TOOL: Opt out of PowerShell tool on Windows (Bedrock/Vertex/Foundry)
+ [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_STOP_HOOK_BLOCK_CAP: Override stop-hook consecutive-block cap (default 8)
~ [cli-flags] claude agents: Agent dashboard; --cwd, --add-dir, --settings, --mcp-config, --model, --effort
- [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_OPUS_4_6_FAST_MODE_OVERRIDE
- [config-env] ANTHROPIC_WORKSPACE_ID
- [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_PREFER_HTTPS
- [config-env] TaskCreated

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.142
item.description:

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.141
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

+ [config-env] terminalSequence: Hook JSON field — emit desktop notifications, window titles, bells
+ [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_PREFER_HTTPS: Clone GitHub plugin sources over HTTPS instead of SSH
+ [config-env] ANTHROPIC_WORKSPACE_ID: Scope minted token to specific workspace in identity federation
+ [workflows-tips] Summarize up to here: Rewind menu option — compress earlier context, keep recent turns
~ [cli-flags] claude agents: Agent view — list sessions; --cwd <path> to scope dir
~ [slash-commands] /feedback: Submit feedback; include recent sessions (alias: /bug)
- [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID
- [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ALTERNATE_SCREEN
- [config-env] CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FEEDBACK_SURVEY_FOR_OTEL

item.title: Claude Code v2.1.139
item.description:
Cheatsheet changes

+ [slash-commands] /goal [condition]: Set completion condition; Claude works across turns until met
+ [slash-commands] /scroll-speed: Tune mouse wheel scroll speed with live preview
+ [keyboard-shortcuts] { / }: Jump between user prompts (transcript view)
+ [keyboard-shortcuts] ?: Show keyboard shortcuts (transcript view)
+ [cli-flags] claude agents: Agent view — list every CC session (running/blocked/done)
+ [cli-flags] claude plugin details <name>: Show plugin component inventory and projected token cost
+ [config-env] CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR: Project dir passed to MCP stdio servers and hooks env
+ [config-env] args: string[]: Hook exec form — spawn directly without shell
+ [config-env] continueOnBlock: PostToolUse: feed rejection reason back to Claude, continue turn
+ [mcp-servers] ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}: Reference project dir in MCP server commands
+ [workflows-tips] API key → no cloud: API key disables Remote Control, /schedule, claude.ai MCP, notifications
- [keyboard-shortcuts] Ctrl V
- [keyboard-shortcuts] P
- [slash-commands] /cost
- [slash-commands] /team-onboarding
- [config-env] wslInheritsWindowsSettings
- [config-env] CwdChanged
- [config-env] FileChanged
